style: A real screenshot from a 1993 Japanese anime TV episode: a hand-painted acetate cel over a painted background, 4:3 broadcast frame; simple 1990s character design (angular face, sharp chin, almond eyes with one plain highlight, single-line nose, chunky pointed hair clumps); thick uniform black outlines, exactly two flat shade tones per colour, no rendered detail, no skin texture, no gradients, no airbrush, no gloss; washed-out warm cel paint, soft VHS picture, faint colour bleed, film grain. Not modern anime, not digital illustration, not detailed, not 3D, not semi-realistic.
him: a confident young man with a short black fade haircut, a neat full beard, a black hoodie and a thin silver chain
her: a stylish young woman with long black wavy hair, gold hoop earrings and a black slip dress
